items.description: Fast inward regeneratively activating and inactivating sodium current.

items.name: Hodgkin-Huxley Delayed-Rectifier Potassium Current
items.description: Outward delayed-rectifier potassium current repolarizing the action potential.

items.name: Hodgkin-Huxley Ohmic Leak Current

items.description: Phase-plane curves whose intersection determines fixed-point stability and Hopf bifurcations.

items.name: Current-Based Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (CUBA-LIF) ODE
items.description: Subthreshold linear RC membrane integration prior to threshold crossing.

items.name: Integrate-and-Fire Threshold Reset and Refractory Rule
items.latex: V(t^-) \ge V_{\mathrm{th}} \implies t_{\mathrm{sp}} = t, \quad V(t^+) \leftarrow V_{\mathrm{reset}}, \quad V(t) = V_{\mathrm{reset}} \ \forall t \in (t_{\mathrm{sp}}, t_{\mathrm{sp}}+\tau_{\mathrm{ref}}]
items.description: Discontinuous spike emission, reset, and absolute refractory clamping rule.

items.name: Conductance-Based Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (COBA-LIF) ODE
items.latex: C_m \frac{dV}{dt} = -g_L(V - E_L) - g_E(t)(V - E_E) - g_I(t)(V - E_I) + I_{\mathrm{ext}}(t)

items.name: Benjamini-Hochberg False Discovery Rate (FDR) Step-Up Threshold
items.description: Controls expected proportion of false positives across multichannel or multi-edge connectome comparisons.

items.description: Penalized log-likelihood criteria balancing goodness-of-fit against model complexity.
